heading: Courses at a Glance
aboutPara1: Approval has been received to commence 5 certificate courses, which will be conducted in an 800-bedded multispecialty teaching hospital equipped with state-of-the-art infrastructure and comprehensive clinical facilities. The hospital has well-established departments including General Medicine, General Surgery, Orthopaedics, Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Paediatrics, Ophthalmology, ENT, Dermatology, Psychiatry, Anaesthesiology, Radiodiagnosis, Emergency Medicine, Intensive Care Units (Medical, Surgical, Cardiac and Neonatal ICUs), Cardiology, Nephrology, Urology, Neurology, Neurosurgery, Oncology, Dentistry, Physiotherapy, Blood Centre, Central Clinical Laboratory, Operation Theatre Complex, Dialysis Unit, and Trauma & Emergency Services.
aboutPara2: Students enrolled in these courses will receive extensive hands-on practical training and supervised clinical exposure in their respective specialties, enabling them to acquire the knowledge, technical skills, and professional competencies required for employment in the healthcare sector.
feeDisclosureText: Fees shown are provisional and subject to final approval. No additional charges without prior written notice.
certificatesText: Issued by Dr. Vithalrao Vikhe Patil Foundation's Paramedical Institute upon successful completion.
